No. 13222, §3, Aug. 17, 2001, 66 F.R. 44025, listed in a table under section 1701 of Title 50 , War and National Defense, provided that: "Provisions for administration of section 38(e) of the Arms Export Control Act ( 22 U.S.C. 2778(e) ) may be made and shall continue in full force and effect until amended or revoked under the authority of section 203 of the Act ( 50 U.S.C. 1702 ). To the extent permitted by law, this order also shall constitute authority for the issuance and continuation in full force and effect of all rules and regulations by the President or his delegate, and all orders, licenses, and other forms of administrative actions issued, taken, or continued in effect pursuant thereto, relating to the administration of section 38(e)."
